settings.title: Pure Speed Engine
settings.body: Full titanium frame construction and variable thickness face technology create exceptional ball speed and distance across the entire clubface, delivering effortless power with every swing.

settings.title: Artistry in Motion
settings.body: Laser-cut Kiriko patterns and 3D emblem structures inspired by 1834 Japanese glass-cutting traditions create visual depth while suppressing unwanted vibration for premium feel and acoustics.

settings.title: Weightless Precision
settings.body: ARMRQ Flight shafts featuring 5-axis hybrid metal mesh with TORAYCA T1100G carbon fiber deliver improved impact efficiency and remarkable stability at weights as low as 45 grams.

settings.hero_sub: Handcrafted in Sakata. Available at Northcrest.
settings.statement_body: Honma's Beres 10 Series represents the tenth generation of Japan's most revered golf club collection. Hand-finished by master Takumi craftsmen in Sakata, each club blends traditional artistry inspired by Edo Kiriko glass-cutting techniques with advanced materials engineered for effortless power and precision. Northcrest is honored to present this exceptional collection.
settings.heritage_para: For over 65 years, Honma has crafted the world's most **luxurious** golf equipment in their Sakata studio. The Beres Collection has long been recognized globally as the choice of golfers who value craftsmanship at its most **elevated** level. Northcrest offers personalized guidance to help you experience the refinement, balance, and performance that define Beres 10.
